citations.quote: Whenever Zac's abilities damage an enemy, he sheds a number of chunks on the ground that remain for a few seconds.
Zac and enemy champions can collect the chunks; an enemy will destroy it, while Zac will heal a portion of his maximum health.

claims.claim: Cell Division drops healing chunks when Zac damages enemies with abilities; enemy champions can destroy these chunks by collecting them.

citations.quote: Periodically when Zac would die, he instead enters resurrection for a period, splitting into four bloblets that can be attacked by enemies. Zac will die once all bloblets are killed.
If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets.

claims.claim: When his resurrection is ready, fatal damage splits him into attackable bloblets; surviving bloblets let him revive, while killing them all kills Zac.

claims.claim: Stretching Strikes hits the first enemy in its path, dealing magic damage, slowing them and tethering them.

citations.quote: While the tether persists, Zac's next basic attack is replaced by a second Stretching Strike
If the two Stretching Strikes affect different targets
Zac displaces them toward each other over 300 units, though not through terrain.

If the two targets are within 700 units of each other, they are instead slammed together through the displacement. Upon impact of each other, both targets are knocked up and stunned for 0.25 seconds and all enemies within the impact are dealt the initial magic damage

claims.claim: If Zac then attacks a different enemy, he pulls the targets toward each other; targets close enough slam together, causing a knockup, stun and area magic damage.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: The tether threatens displacement through a follow-up attack on another enemy.

row.answer: Stretching Strikes hits the first enemy in its path, dealing magic damage, slowing them and tethering them. If Zac then attacks a different enemy, he pulls the targets toward each other; targets close enough slam together, causing a knockup, stun and area magic damage.
